noPermission.title: Fabric cutting is not yours here
noPermission.body: Your role does not cut at this table. Ask your team leader.

held.online: This needs the network. Wait for it, then do it.
held.trolleys: Your role does not send trolleys to sewing.
held.secondary: Your role does not move secondary processes.

camera.error: The camera does not start. Type the code instead.

wrong.notTicket: {code} is no cut ticket. Scan the ticket on the lay sheet.
wrong.notRoll: {code} is no roll label. Scan the label on the roll.
wrong.notBundle: {code} is no bundle ticket. Scan a bundle.
wrong.notTrolley: {code} is no trolley label: letters and digits, no spaces, at most 20.
wrong.notFound: Nothing with {code} at this site. Check the label, or ask the cutting office.
wrong.notOnTablet: {code} is not on this tablet and there is no network. Scan it again when the network is back.
wrong.otherFactory: {code} is a label of another factory.
wrong.otherTicket: {code} is not this lay's ticket. Scan the ticket of the lay you cut.

start.scanHint: The ticket is on the lay sheet: start, spread, count and cut from it.
start.recutsHint: Panels asked by sewing or quality
start.sewingHint: Bundles onto a trolley, then to a line
start.none: No ticket waits to be cut at this site.

ticket.notNow: Not now: see why on the card.
ticket.leather: This cut order cuts leather hide by hide: cut it on Cut a hide.

spread.scanHint_one: {count} more ply is needed: scan the roll you spread it from.
spread.scanHint_other: {count} more plies are needed: scan each roll as you spread it.
spread.full: Every ply is spread. Count both ends next.
spread.empty: No roll on this lay yet. Scan the first roll.
spread.report: The lay report, roll by roll

held.nothing: Nothing is spread yet: scan a roll first.
held.planned: The lay starts with its first roll: scan a roll first.

roll.subject: Ticket {ticket} · lay {seq} of {of}
roll.scan: Scan this roll again to add it

held.plies: Type the plies from this roll.
held.full: The lay has every ply: count both ends.

warning.END_DIFFERS: The roll end measured back differs from what the lay report leaves on it. The warehouse measures the roll again.
warning.WIDTH_UNKNOWN: This roll's width is not known: check it is as wide as the marker.
warning.SHRINKAGE_UNKNOWN: This roll's shrinkage group is not known.
warning.SHADE_UNKNOWN: This roll's shade is not known: check it matches the lay.
warning.LOT_NOT_RELEASED: This roll's lot is not released by quality yet.
warning.SHADES_ACROSS_LAYS: The lays of this cut order are cut from different shades.
warning.SHRINKAGE_ACROSS_LAYS: The lays of this cut order are cut from different shrinkage groups.
warning.PLANNED_ON_OTHER_LINE: This bundle's work order is planned on another line.
warning.other: The office noted something about this roll: the cutting office has the details.

count.lead_one: {count} ply spread. Count the plies at both ends of the lay.
count.lead_other: {count} plies spread. Count the plies at both ends of the lay.
count.hardStop: Any difference stops the cut: recount before cutting.
count.differFix: The ends must say the same number of plies. Count both ends again, or correct the rolls of the lay.

held.empty: Type the plies at both ends.

cut.scan: Scan the ticket when the cut is done
cut.scanHint: Scan {code} again at the end of cutting.

stickers.lead: Each ply and part gets its number, so a garment's parts come from one ply.
stickers.noPrinter: No label printer here: the stickers are shown, not printed. Ask the cutting office to set one up.

held.noParts: The pattern lists no parts of this material to number: the cutting office names them.

held.closed: The cut order is reconciled: the fabric used no longer changes.

fabric.notCut: The lay is not cut yet: its fabric used is confirmed after the cut.
fabric.savedText: The fabric is booked to the work orders of this lay. Scan the next ticket.

recuts.title: Recut tickets
recuts.scanHint: Or open one from the list.

recut.cutFrom: Cut it from lot {lot}: the same shade as the bundle.
recut.cutFromBoth: Cut it from lot {lot} or from end bits of the same shade.
recut.cutFromEnds: Cut it from end bits of the bundle's shade.
recut.noPrinter: No label printer here: the ticket is shown, not printed.

trolleys.title: Send to sewing
trolleys.scanHint: A new label starts loading; a trolley on its way to this line is received.
trolleys.here: This tablet is at line {line}: trolleys coming to it are listed first.
trolleys.none: No trolley is loading or on its way.

trolley.scan: Scan a bundle onto the trolley
trolley.scanHint: Scan each bundle as it goes on. Tap a bundle to take it off.
trolley.new: A new trolley: scan its first bundle.
trolley.empty: No bundle on this trolley yet.

held.empty: Scan a bundle onto the trolley first.

trolley.receiveLead_one: {count} bundle on this trolley. Tap a bundle that is not here, then confirm.
trolley.receiveLead_other: {count} bundles on this trolley. Tap a bundle that is not here, then confirm.

none.SENT: This trolley is on its way to line {line}.

process.title: {bundle} waits for a process before sewing
process.waits: It goes to sewing once its process is done.
process.elsewhere: Its process is done at another station first.

print.failedHint: The printer did not print it: check the printer, then print again.

keys.enter: Open the row with the focus

notice.refused: The office refused it. Ask the cutting office.

NOT_FABRIC.message: This cut order cuts leather hide by hide.
NOT_FABRIC.fix: Cut it on Cut a hide.

CUT_ORDER_NOT_AT_TABLE.message: This cut order is not released for cutting.
CUT_ORDER_NOT_AT_TABLE.fix: Ask the cutting office to release it.

TICKET_NOT_STARTED.message: The ticket is not started yet.
TICKET_NOT_STARTED.fix: Start cutting from the ticket first.

LAY_NOT_OPEN.message: This lay is cut or cancelled: its report no longer changes.
LAY_NOT_OPEN.fix: Scan the ticket of the next lay.

LAY_NOT_SPREAD.message: This lay is not spread yet.

LAY_FULL.message: With these plies the lay would have more than it plans.
LAY_FULL.fix: Lower the plies from this roll.

ROLL_SHORT.message: This roll is too short for these plies.
ROLL_SHORT.fix: Lower the plies, or ask the warehouse to measure the roll again.

ROLL_NOT_IN_LAY.message: This roll is not on this lay.
ROLL_NOT_IN_LAY.fix: Scan a roll of this lay.

NOT_LAST_ROLL.message: Only the last roll is taken back.

PLY_TOO_SHORT.message: A ply is shorter than the marker.
PLY_TOO_SHORT.fix: Ask the cutting office for the lay's length.

NOTHING_SPREAD.message: Nothing is spread on this lay yet.

PLIES_DIFFER.message: The two ends do not match. Recount before cutting.

COUNT_NOT_SPREAD.message: Both ends say a number the rolls did not give.
COUNT_NOT_SPREAD.fix: Recount, or correct the rolls of the lay.

LAY_NOT_CUT.message: The lay is not cut yet.
LAY_NOT_CUT.fix: Scan the ticket again when the cut is done.

CONSUMPTION_CLOSED.message: The cut order is reconciled: the fabric used no longer changes.

ROLL_NOT_IN_STOCK.message: This roll is not in stock.
ROLL_NOT_IN_STOCK.fix: Scan another roll, or ask the warehouse.

ROLL_OTHER_MATERIAL.message: This roll is another material or colour.
ROLL_OTHER_MATERIAL.fix: Scan a roll of the ticket's material.

ROLL_TOO_NARROW.message: This roll is narrower than the marker.

ROLL_REJECTED.message: This roll failed its incoming inspection.
ROLL_REJECTED.fix: Put it aside and scan another roll.

LOT_HELD.message: This roll's lot is on hold.
LOT_HELD.fix: Put it aside and scan another roll.

LOT_NOT_USABLE.message: This roll's lot is rejected or blocked.
LOT_NOT_USABLE.fix: Put it aside and scan another roll.

MIXED_SHADE.message: This roll is another shade than the lay.
MIXED_SHADE.fix: Scan a roll of the lay's shade.

MIXED_SHRINKAGE.message: This roll is another shrinkage group than the lay.
MIXED_SHRINKAGE.fix: Scan a roll of the lay's shrinkage group.

LAY_NOT_PLANNED.message: This lay is not planned any more.

ROLL_TWICE.message: This roll is on the lay already.

TICKET_VOID.fix: Ask the cutting office for its new ticket.

CUT_ORDER_NOT_RELEASED.message: The cut order is not released.
CUT_ORDER_NOT_RELEASED.fix: Ask the cutting office to release it.

PLIES_NOT_COUNTED.message: The plies are not counted at both ends yet.
PLIES_NOT_COUNTED.fix: Count both ends before the cut.

PLIES_BEYOND_COUNT.message: These plies go beyond the count.

PLIES_NUMBERED.message: Every ply of this lay is numbered already.
PLIES_NUMBERED.fix: Print the run again if a sticker is missing.

NO_PARTS.message: The pattern lists no parts to number.
NO_PARTS.fix: Ask the cutting office to name the parts.

RUN_TOO_BIG.message: Too many stickers in one run.

WORK_ORDER_ON_HOLD.message: A work order of this ticket is on hold.
WORK_ORDER_ON_HOLD.fix: Ask the cutting office: nothing is cut for it now.

WORK_ORDER_NOT_OPEN.message: A work order of this ticket is not open.

FLOOR_NOT_READY.message: The floor of this site is not ready for real work yet.
FLOOR_NOT_READY.fix: Ask the office: the workers' notice comes first.

OVER_ISSUE.message: More fabric than the work orders need.
OVER_ISSUE.fix: The cutting office confirms it in the office.

QUALITY_HOLD.message: The fabric of a roll is on a quality hold.

RESERVED_FOR_OTHER.message: A roll is reserved for another work order.

LENGTH_BEYOND_LEFT.message: A roll does not have this much fabric left.
LENGTH_BEYOND_LEFT.fix: Ask the warehouse to measure the roll again.

BUNDLE_NOT_ACTIVE.fix: Scan another bundle, or ask your team leader.

NOT_OF_CELL.message: This is not the bundle's colour and size.

NOT_A_PART.message: This part is not on the pattern.

NO_SOURCE.message: The recut names no lot and no end bits.

LOT_NOT_SAME_SHADE.message: The lot is another shade than the bundle.

REPLACEMENT_NOT_OPEN.message: The request is not open any more.

REPLACEMENT_HAS_TICKET.message: The request has its ticket already.

REPLACEMENT_OTHER_CELL.message: The request is for another colour or size.

REPLACEMENT_OTHER_PART.message: The request is for another part.

TICKET_IS_CUT.message: This is a cut ticket, not a recut.
TICKET_IS_CUT.fix: Scan it on the start screen.

BUNDLE_VOID.message: The bundle of this recut is void.

KIND_OPEN_ALREADY.message: This bundle has this process open already.

ON_A_TROLLEY.message: This bundle is on a trolley already.
ON_A_TROLLEY.fix: Take it off the trolley first.

NOT_A_WORK_CENTRE.message: This station is no work centre for this process.
NOT_A_WORK_CENTRE.fix: Do it at its own station.

WORK_CENTRE_OUTSIDE.fix: The office sends it to the workshop.

SUBCONTRACT_NEEDED.message: An outside process needs its subcontract order.

SUBCONTRACT_NOT_SENDABLE.message: The subcontract order cannot take it now.

OUTSIDE_FROM_OFFICE.message: An outside process is sent from the office.

NOT_A_TROLLEY.fix: Scan the label on the trolley.

TROLLEY_SENT.message: This trolley is on its way already.

NO_OPEN_TROLLEY.message: No trolley with this label is loading or on its way.

TROLLEY_NOT_LOADING.message: This trolley was sent: its bundles stay on it.

TROLLEY_NOT_SENT.message: This trolley is still being loaded.
TROLLEY_NOT_SENT.fix: It is received once it was sent.

TROLLEY_FULL.fix: Send it, and load another trolley.

LINE_NEEDED.message: No line is planned for this bundle.
LINE_NEEDED.fix: Ask your team leader which line it goes to.

PROCESS_PENDING.message: This bundle waits for a process before sewing.
PROCESS_PENDING.fix: Do its process first, then load it.

ON_THIS_TROLLEY.message: This bundle is on this trolley already.

ON_ANOTHER_TROLLEY.message: This bundle is on another trolley.
ON_ANOTHER_TROLLEY.fix: Take it off that trolley first.

NOT_ON_TROLLEY.message: This bundle is not on this trolley.
NOT_ON_TROLLEY.fix: Scan a bundle of this trolley.

OTHER_LINE.message: This trolley goes to another line.
OTHER_LINE.fix: Send it on to its line.
